```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ipumsr)      # used to read IPUMS extracts
#library(plyr)        # used for ddply to calculate some within HH variables
library(dplyr)       # used for data-cleaning and filtering
library(tidyverse)  #used to reshape long to wide on some variables


# Load project configuration
source(here::here("R", "load_config.R"))
cfg <- load_config()

# Define IPUMS input files 2019
ipums_2019_1year <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$input_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$input_2019
)

# Define IPUMS input files 2022
ipums_2022_1year <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$input_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$input_2022_1year
)

ipums_2022_5year <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$input_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$input_2022_5year
)

# Define IPUMS input file 2024
ipums_2024_1year <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$input_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$input_2024_1year
)

ipums_2024_5year <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$input_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$input_2024_5year
)

stopifnot(file.exists(ipums_2022_1year))
stopifnot(file.exists(ipums_2022_5year))
stopifnot(file.exists(ipums_2024_1year))
stopifnot(file.exists(ipums_2024_5year))

```

```{r}

ipums_files <- list(
  "2019" = ipums_2019_1year,
  "2022" = ipums_2022_1year,
  "2024" = ipums_2024_1year
)

cpi <- c(
  "2019" = 299.433,
  "2022" = 344.416,
  "2024" = 373.321   
)

target_cpi <- cpi["2022"]   # all incomes converted to 2022 dollars


process_ipums <- function(yr, ipums_file, cpi_value, target_cpi) {

  ddi <- read_ipums_ddi(ipums_file)

  year_check <- read_ipums_micro(
    ddi,
    vars = "YEAR"
  )

  years_found <- unique(year_check$YEAR)

  if (!all(years_found == yr)) {
    stop(
      sprintf(
        "Expected YEAR=%s. Found: %s",
        yr,
        paste(sort(years_found), collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  ipums_data <- read_ipums_micro(ddi)

  data <- ipums_data %>%
    filter(
      GQ == 1,
      COUNTYFIP == 73,
      YEAR == yr
    )

  stopifnot(all(data$STATEFIP == 6))
  stopifnot(all(data$COUNTYFIP == 73))
  stopifnot(all(data$GQ == 1))

  data <- data %>%
    select(
      -starts_with("REPWT"),
      -STATEFIP,
      -COUNTYFIP,
      -GQ
    )

  data_HH <- subset(
    data,
    select = c(
      HHWT, PERNUM, PERWT, SERIAL,
      HHINCOME, AGE, RACE, RACED,
      SEX, HHTYPE, RELATE, RELATED,
      EMPSTAT, LABFORCE
    )
  )

  # Household Size
  HHSize <- data_HH %>%
    group_by(SERIAL) %>%
    summarise(
      HHSize = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  data <- right_join(data, HHSize, by = "SERIAL")

  # Children
  HHChild <- data_HH %>%
    select(SERIAL, RELATE, AGE) %>%
    mutate(
      IsChild = if_else(
        !(RELATE %in% c(1, 2)) & AGE < 18,
        1,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(SERIAL) %>%
    summarise(
      ChildPresent = max(IsChild, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  data <- right_join(data, HHChild, by = "SERIAL")

  # Seniors
  HHSenior <- data_HH %>%
    select(SERIAL, AGE) %>%
    mutate(
      SeniorPresent = if_else(AGE >= 65, 1, 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(SERIAL) %>%
    summarise(
      SeniorPresent = max(SeniorPresent, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  data <- right_join(data, HHSenior, by = "SERIAL")

  # Labor force
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      LF = if_else(
        (AGE >= 16 & AGE <= 70) &
          LABFORCE == 2,
        1,
        0
      )
    )

  # Sex
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      SEX = if_else(SEX == 1, 1, 0)
    )

  # Age categories
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      AgeCode = case_when(
        AGE < 15 ~ 1,
        AGE >= 15 & AGE < 25 ~ 2,
        AGE >= 25 & AGE < 70 ~ 3,
        AGE >= 70 ~ 4,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )

  data <- data %>%
    filter(RELATE == 1)

  data <- data %>%
    filter(HHINCOME > 0)

  # CPI adjustment to 2022 dollars
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      ADJ_HHINCOME = HHINCOME *
        (target_cpi / cpi_value)
    )

  cut_points <- c(
    0, 15000, 30000, 45000, 60000,
    75000, 100000, 125000, 150000,
    200000, 300000, 500000,
    700000, 900000, Inf
  )

  incrementing_labels <- paste0(
    "Inc",
    seq_len(length(cut_points) - 1)
  )

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      IncCat = cut(
        ADJ_HHINCOME,
        breaks = cut_points,
        labels = incrementing_labels,
        right = FALSE,
        ordered_result = TRUE
      )
    )

  dummies <- as.data.frame(
    model.matrix(~ IncCat - 1, data = data)
  )

  colnames(dummies) <- sub(
    "^IncCat",
    "",
    colnames(dummies)
  )

  data <- bind_cols(data, dummies)
  

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    placebo = sample(
      1:100,
      size = nrow(data),
      replace = TRUE
    )
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    placebo_trend = placebo*(YEAR-2018)
    )

  rm(
    ddi,
    ipums_data,
    year_check,
    years_found,
    data_HH,
    HHSize,
    HHChild,
    HHSenior,
    dummies
  )

  data
}

years <- c(2019, 2022, 2024)

ACS_list <- lapply(
  years,
  function(yr) {
    process_ipums(
      yr = yr,
      ipums_file = ipums_files[[as.character(yr)]],
      cpi_value = cpi[as.character(yr)],
      target_cpi = target_cpi
    )
  }
)

names(ACS_list) <- paste0("ACS_", years, "_1Y")

```

## create year mean variable for input into predictions
```{r}

## Multiply all variables by HHWT in the sample.  Even for head of HH, we care
# about how many such similarly headed households there are, not how many such
# people (PERWT) there are


years <- c(2019, 2022, 2024)

ACS_Means <- lapply(years, function(yr) {
  ACS_list[[paste0("ACS_", yr, "_1Y")]] %>%
    summarise(
      YEAR = first(YEAR),
      ADJ_HHINCOME = weighted.mean(ADJ_HHINCOME, HHWT),
      HHINCOME = weighted.mean(HHINCOME, HHWT),
      SeniorPresent = weighted.mean(SeniorPresent, HHWT),
      ChildPresent = weighted.mean(ChildPresent, HHWT),
      AGE = weighted.mean(AGE, HHWT),
      SEX = weighted.mean(SEX, HHWT),
      LF = weighted.mean(LF, HHWT),
      HHSize = weighted.mean(HHSize, HHWT),
      placebo = weighted.mean(placebo),
      NHH = sum(HHWT)
    )
})


ACS_1year_means <-bind_rows(ACS_Means)


```


## Create observed bin counts from the ACS data by year

```{r}



years <- c(2019, 2022, 2024)

ACS_IncCat_Counts <- bind_rows(
  lapply(years, function(yr) {
    ACS_list[[paste0("ACS_", yr, "_1Y")]] %>%
      group_by(IncCat) %>%
      summarise(
        HH_Count = sum(HHWT, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(YEAR = yr)
  })
) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = IncCat,
    values_from = HH_Count
  ) %>%
  arrange(YEAR)


```


## Export CSV

```{r}

# Create output directory if needed
dir.create(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Map years to output filenames in config
output_files <- list(
  "2019" = cfg$IPUMS$output_file_2019_1year,
  "2022" = cfg$IPUMS$output_file_2022_1year,
  "2024" = cfg$IPUMS$output_file_2024_1year
)



verify_export <- function(df, output_file) {

  write.csv(
    df,
    output_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  cat("Dataset saved to:", output_file, "\n")

  exported_data <- read.csv(output_file)

  stopifnot(
    nrow(exported_data) == nrow(df),
    identical(names(exported_data), names(df))
  )

  cat("Export verification passed.\n")
  cat("Rows:", nrow(exported_data), "\n")
  cat("Columns:", ncol(exported_data), "\n\n")
}


# Export each ACS dataset
for (yr in years) {

  verify_export(
    ACS_list[[paste0("ACS_", yr, "_1Y")]],
    file.path(
      cfg$paths$output_dir,
      output_files[[as.character(yr)]]
    )
  )

}

# export means
output_means <- file.path(
  cfg$paths$output_dir,
  cfg$IPUMS$outout_file_ACS_1year_means
)


# Write CSV
write.csv(
  ACS_1year_means,
  output_means,

)


verify_export(
  ACS_1year_means,
  file.path(
    cfg$paths$output_dir,
    cfg$IPUMS$outout_file_ACS_1year_means
  )
)

#clean up the memory
rm(list = ls())
```
